procedural_matters: Anne-Tjitske Boekhoven (ATB), a member of NED 7073, had her foot injured during launching. ATB was checked by the event physician.
ATB went out sailing but returned to shore due to pain at 12:30.
ATB went to rest, with access to her phone, and came back to the harbour at five o’clock. ATB then submitted a request for redress at 17:39.
The time limit for a request for redress was a soon as possible after the relevant information was available. The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(a).
conclusions: NED 7073 failed to deliver the request for redress as soon as reasonably possible after the relevant information was available, as required by RRS 61.2(b)(3). There was no good reason for the international jury to extend the time.
decision: Request invalid DECISION Request for Redress Request No.: 01 Printed: 2025-07-30 15:19
